login.privyNotConfigured: Privy is not configured. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_PRIVY_APP_ID to use login.
login.requestTimedOut: Request timed out. Check your connection and try again.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Your organization overview: balance, key metrics, and recent activity.
dashboard.storeSubtitle: Accept payments, pay suppliers, and withdraw to your bank.

cashOutPage.title: Withdraw to bank
cashOutPage.subtitle: Move your USD balance to your bank account. Arrives in minutes via our off-ramp partner.
cashOutPage.invalidAmount: Enter a valid amount greater than 0.
cashOutPage.bankRequired: Account holder, country, and account number are required.
cashOutPage.withdrawQueuedNoEta: Withdrawal initiated. Funds will arrive shortly.
cashOutPage.hint: Funds are sent via our trusted off-ramp partner. Zero hidden fees.

checkoutPage.title: Get paid
checkoutPage.subtitle: Create a payment link to share with your customer. They pay in USD and the money lands directly in your account.
checkoutPage.invalidAmount: Enter a valid amount greater than 0.
checkoutPage.linkReady: Payment link ready — share it with your customer

errors.notFoundBody: The page you’re looking for doesn’t exist or was moved.
errors.errorBody: An error occurred. You can try again or go back home.

transactionsPage.title: Transactions
transactionsPage.subtitle: Organization wallet activity. Date, amount, type, source, status. Each row links to Stellar Expert.

vaultPage.title: Vault / yield
vaultPage.subtitle: Organization wallet DeFi allocation: balance in vault, APY, accrued yield.
vaultPage.feeNote: We earn 10% of your yield. You keep 90%. No lockup.

dashboardTransactionsWidget.title: Recent transactions
dashboardTransactionsWidget.subtitle: Organization wallet activity. Each row links to Stellar Expert for audit.
dashboardTransactionsWidget.storeSubtitle: Payments received, supplier payments, and withdrawals.

ledgerShadowBalance.initBody: Run the SQL in docs/supabase-shadow-ledger.sql to enable shadow payment rail balances.
ledgerShadowBalance.title: Internal ledger (shadow rail POC)
ledgerShadowBalance.footnote: Off-chain ledger after ops confirms fiat. This is not your on-chain Stellar USDC balance.

auditPage.title: Audit log
auditPage.subtitle: Bank account added, recovery method changed, payout to X, etc.

settingsPage.title: Settings
settingsPage.totpHelp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to enable 2FA.
settingsPage.sozuTagBody: Claim a $tag for your organization so other apps can send you money using the same tag directory.
settingsPage.recoveryWalletBody: Manage recovery methods for your account and smart wallet. 2FA is in Security above; here you can back up your wallet recovery phrase or set a recovery email.
settingsPage.recoveryPhraseBody: Export or back up your wallet secret phrase (shown only when you create a new wallet). Never share it.
settingsPage.recoveryPhraseAfter: Available after you create a wallet in Profile.
settingsPage.recoveryEmailBody: Optional email used for account recovery. Your login email is already used for Privy recovery.
settingsPage.verificationBody: Optional: for off-ramp and higher limits, we may collect minimal business or bank details as required by our off-ramp partner. You can complete this when you first add a bank account.
settingsPage.bankAccountsBody: Add or edit bank accounts (2FA required). Default for your withdrawals; others for payouts to providers.
settingsPage.storesBody: Connect Shopify, WooCommerce, or custom stores. Same wallet and transaction list.
settingsPage.storesDocs: See docs/ecommerce-integration.md for widget and API.

paymentsPocPage.title: Payments (POC)
paymentsPocPage.subtitle: Shadow payment rail: create CLP orders, track internal ledger USDC (credited when ops confirms fiat). On-chain wallet balance is separate—see Overview.
paymentsPocPage.withdrawHelp: Queues a request for operations. After CLP is sent manually, ops marks fulfilled and ledger USDC is debited.

wallsPage.title: Payment walls
wallsPage.subtitle: Create walls for in-store (QR / kiosk). Shareable link per wall.
wallsPage.name: Name

adminPage.title: Admin
adminPage.subtitle: Activate user profiles and fund their wallet. Classic accounts (G...) are funded with XLM via createAccount when you click Activate (requires STELLAR_FUNDER_SECRET). Smart accounts (C...) will use a separate Soroban flow — see docs/smart-accounts.md.
adminPage.forbidden: You don’t have permission to view this page.
adminPage.fundedOk: User allowed and account funded. Tx: {hash}…
adminPage.allowedNoFund: User allowed. (No G address to fund or STELLAR_FUNDER_SECRET not set.)
adminPage.footnote: Activate sets the user as allowed. To fully activate their smart wallet, call your contract and deposit the required XLM (e.g. from your treasury) — plug in that logic in the API route.

keysPage.title: Keys & custody
keysPage.custodyIntro: You have full custody; we don’t hold your funds. Your keys are derived and stored according to your recovery method. We never custody principal.
keysPage.passkeyBody: Create a passkey (Face ID, Touch ID, or device PIN) to sign in without email. Stored by Privy—not in our database. You can then choose "I have a passkey" on the login page.
keysPage.passkeyOk: You have a passkey set up. Use it to sign in from the login page.
keysPage.recoveryBody: Simple path: request a recovery link to your email to restore access.
keysPage.recoveryBtn: Send recovery link to my email
keysPage.recoveryAdvanced: Advanced: recovery phrase or hardware key — available in Settings for power users.

shadowOraclePage.title: Payments oracle (POC)
shadowOraclePage.subtitle: Match incoming CLP to an order, then confirm to credit the merchant's internal ledger USDC. For withdrawals, send CLP off-platform first, then mark fulfilled to debit ledger.
shadowOraclePage.forbidden: You don’t have permission to view this page.
shadowOraclePage.confirmSuccess: Confirmed. Credited {credited} minor units. New balance (minor): {balance}
shadowOraclePage.lowLiquidity: Below alert threshold ({threshold} USDC). Top up the LP account.

creditPage.title: Credit
creditPage.intro: Credit eligibility is based on a trustpoint system. Recipients build trustpoints through repayment history and engagement. The pool below shows total volume for microcredits, how much is allocated to recipients, and the health of payback cycles.
creditPage.clickSegment: Click a segment to see detail
creditPage.allocationSubtitle: Microcredits disbursed and trustpoints. Health indicates payback cycle status.

payoutsPage.title: Payouts
payoutsPage.subtitle: Withdraw to your bank or to providers/employees. 2FA required for large payouts.
payoutsPage.addBankFirst: Add a bank account in Settings first (2FA required).
payoutsPage.batchHelp: Add recipients and amount per recipient. You can add several to the same batch.
payoutsPage.sendUsdcSubtitle: Optional: send USDC to another Stellar address.
payoutsPage.payoutPasswordPlaceholder: Password you set for this org wallet
payoutsPage.unlockBody: Payouts are signed with the wallet shown on Profile. Use that wallet's passphrase or paste its secret key.
payoutsPage.alert2fa: Enable 2FA in Settings and try again.
payoutsPage.alertBatchRecipients: Add at least one recipient with an amount.

recipientsPage.title: Recipients
recipientsPage.subtitle: Providers and employees. One-off or scheduled payouts from the same wallet.
recipientsPage.bankOrStellarHint: Provide at least one: bank account or Stellar address.
recipientsPage.sameAmountHint: Leave empty to set amount per recipient.
recipientsPage.footerNote: Payouts appear as "Payout – [Recipient]" in the transaction list with Stellar Expert link.
recipientsPage.superAdminNote: Stellar payouts are sent from your organization's wallet (see Profile). Fund the org wallet with XLM and USDC; you authorize each payout as super-admin.
recipientsPage.bankOrStellarRequired: Add a bank account in Settings, or enter a Stellar address for this recipient.
recipientsPage.twoFaLarge: 2FA may be required for large payouts.

profilePage.title: Profile
profilePage.adminPayoutWalletBody: Your organization has no disbursement wallet yet. Set up this wallet to sign payouts, or create an organization with a wallet above. Fund it with XLM and add a USDC trustline.
profilePage.fundXlmTrustlineBefore: Fund this address with XLM, then add a USDC trustline. On testnet, use
profilePage.fundXlmTrustlineAfter: to get XLM, then add the USDC trustline (e.g. via Stellar Laboratory or your wallet).
profilePage.setupWalletPrompt: Set up a wallet so you can sign payouts. Choose one:
profilePage.passphraseVsKeypairNote: Passphrase: we derive a key (you never see the secret). Keypair: you back up the secret once and use it to unlock when paying.
profilePage.organizationIntro: Create an organization to associate payouts. Set a payout password — you will enter it each time you approve a payout (your key never leaves your device).
profilePage.payoutPasswordOrgPlaceholder: Enter a password you will use to approve payouts
profilePage.payoutPasswordOrgHint: You will enter this when approving each payout. We never store it.
profilePage.legacyFlowPrefix: Legacy flow (server generates key; you must back up the secret):
profilePage.orgCreatedBody: Your wallet is secured with your payout password. You will enter it when approving each payout.
profilePage.saveRecoveryCodeBody: Use this if you forget your payout password.
profilePage.saveOrgKeyBody: Store the secret key securely. Payouts are sent from this wallet. You can reveal it again from this page later.
profilePage.orgDisbursementBody: Payouts are sent from this wallet. As a super admin you can reveal the secret key to back it up or use it elsewhere.
profilePage.reSecureHint: Encrypt the wallet with a password only you know; the server will no longer be able to decrypt it.
profilePage.orgPayoutWalletBody: All Stellar payouts to recipients are sent from this wallet. You authorize each payout; the org wallet signs. Fund it with XLM and USDC (testnet or mainnet).
profilePage.smartWalletBody: Your Stellar account for receiving and sending. You control the keys; we only store your public address.
profilePage.trustlineSignHint: You will be asked to authenticate with your wallet secret to sign the transaction. It is not stored.
profilePage.settingsRecoveryWallet: To connect a different wallet, go to Settings → Recovery & wallet.
profilePage.saveSecretWarning: Save your secret key somewhere safe. We never store it. You won’t see it again.
profilePage.backupConfirmCheckbox: I’ve saved my secret key and won’t lose it
profilePage.noWalletLinked: No wallet linked yet. Create one or connect an existing Stellar account.
profilePage.createVsConnectNote: Create: we generate a keypair in your browser; you back up the secret. Connect: you prove ownership by signing a message.
profilePage.recoveryMethodsBody: Login uses Privy (email + passkey). Configure wallet recovery in Settings.
profilePage.loginPrivySub: Email and passkey — 2FA is handled by Privy
profilePage.recoveryPhraseSub: Back up your wallet secret (shown when you create a wallet)
profilePage.profileActivated: Your profile is activated. You can use your Stellar wallet for payments.
profilePage.resetPayoutPasswordBody: Enter your recovery code and a new payout password. Your wallet will be re-encrypted.
profilePage.migrationModalBody: Paste your org wallet secret (from Reveal above), then set a payout password. The key will be re-encrypted and the server will no longer be able to decrypt it.
profilePage.signTransactionBody: Enter your wallet secret key to authorize adding the USDC trustline. It is used only to sign this transaction and is not stored or sent to our servers.
profilePage.trustlineSecretRequired: Enter your wallet secret key to authorize this transaction.
profilePage.secretMismatchWallet: This secret key does not match your registered wallet.
profilePage.enterPayoutPasswordOrg: Enter a payout password to secure your organization wallet.
profilePage.migrationSecretMismatch: This secret key does not match your organization wallet.

disbursementsPage.title: Batch disbursements
disbursementsPage.subtitle: Create payment batches via the Stellar Disbursement Platform. Recipients receive an invite email and register on SozuCredit.
disbursementsPage.sdpWarning: Warning: could not load wallets/assets from SDP ({error}). Check SDP_API_URL in your env.
disbursementsPage.walletHint: This is the mobile/web app your recipients will use to register and claim their payment. It is pre-configured — you don't need to change it.
disbursementsPage.verificationHint: Used by SDP to verify the recipient's identity during wallet registration.
disbursementsPage.csvColumns: Required columns: email, id, amount, verification
disbursementsPage.errorNoRecipients: Add at least one recipient before creating the batch.
disbursementsPage.errorMissingAmount: Every recipient must have an amount (or set a default above).
disbursementsPage.errorMissingEmail: Every recipient must have an email address.
disbursementsPage.sdpEnvHint: Set SDP_API_URL, SDP_ADMIN_EMAIL, and SDP_ADMIN_PASSWORD in your environment variables.
disbursementsPage.empty: No disbursements yet. Click "New batch" to create the first one.
disbursementsPage.noPayments: No payments yet. Add recipients manually or upload a CSV.
disbursementsPage.disbursementStarted: Disbursement started. Payments are being processed.
disbursementsPage.invitesSent: Invites sent: {sent} sent, {skipped} skipped (already registered), {failed} failed.
disbursementsPage.deleteConfirm: Delete batch "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
disbursementsPage.deleteStartedError: Only draft or ready batches can be deleted (not started).
disbursementsPage.adminRequiredHint: Batch delete requires admin role on your profile.
disbursementsPage.authorizeBody: Confirm with your passkey to start payments from your organization's treasury. Only authorized administrators can approve this action.
disbursementsPage.authorizePasskeyUnsupported: This device does not support passkeys.
disbursementsPage.authorizePasskeyFallbackHint: Passkey approval failed on this device. Scan the QR code with a phone that has your passkey.
disbursementsPage.authorizeQrAlt: QR code to approve on another device
disbursementsPage.authorizeQrHint: Scan with your phone camera, log in with the same account, and approve with your passkey.
disbursementsPage.authorizeWaitingPhone: Waiting for approval on your phone…
disbursementsPage.authorizeSessionExpired: Authorization session expired. Close and try again.
disbursementsPage.authorizeSessionNotFound: Authorization session not found or expired.
disbursementsPage.authorizeSmartWalletRequired: Set up your passkey smart wallet on Profile before authorizing disbursements.
disbursementsPage.authorizeKitNotReady: Smart wallet is still loading. Try again in a moment.
disbursementsPage.authorizePasskeyFailed: Passkey approval failed. Try again or use your phone.
disbursementsPage.authorizeMobileBody: Use your passkey to authorize this batch on a compatible device.
disbursementsPage.authorizeMobileDone: Approved. You can return to your computer — payments will start automatically.
